Leisurely breakfast
Oct 2024 • Couples
Mr. Hung greeted us and cleaned our table and took our order. We has just walked there along the beach from our resort about 10-15 minutes away and the walk was worth it. We both ordered bread and egg sandwiches since it was breakfast and they were fresh and tasty. My wife ordered fresh squeezed orange juice and it was fantastic. I ordered local Đánh Thanh sparking water which is better than Perrier. We wee still hungry so we ordered another local favorite hen ( small clams) with awesome seasoning with sesame seed rice crackers. Again, very delicious. The whole affair was an unbelievable value at $7 usd. Needless to say, we strongly recommend this fine little establishment and we will be back again to try his pho and fried noodles!! Thank you Anh Hung. We love your restaurant and kind service.

Sandwich by the Sea
May 2024 • Friends
Mr. Hung is a great host. He and his family are friendly and speak English well. This restaurant is within walking distance of a good, free, beach. 
I was looking for bánh mi trứng gà, egg sandwich on a baguette. The sandwich was good but Mr. Hung's action made it even better. Apparently fresh out of bánh mi, Mr. Hung jumped onto his motorbike and went to buy a couple of bánh mi!

We are in Đà Nẵng often and will be frequenting this restaurant!
